name: Amazon SDE Loop
blurb: The full Amazon software engineering on-site: a Leadership-Principles-heavy behavioral, two coding rounds, an object-oriented design, a system design, and a bar-raiser.

rounds.title: Intro & Behavioral (Leadership Principles)
rounds.focus: Anchor every answer to Amazon Leadership Principles (Ownership, Customer Obsession, Dive Deep). Push for STAR structure and the candidate's individual contribution.

rounds.title: Coding I
rounds.focus: Clean, working code first; then complexity and edge cases. Probe data-structure choice.

rounds.title: Coding II
rounds.focus: Harder algorithmic problem; watch for optimal complexity and how they handle a bug under time pressure.

rounds.title: Object-Oriented / Low-Level Design
rounds.focus: Class model, responsibilities, and extensibility. Deep-dive one or two components rather than skimming.

rounds.title: System Design
rounds.focus: Scale, data model, and failure modes. When they introduce a component, probe why it, tradeoffs, and alternatives.

rounds.title: Bar Raiser
rounds.focus: Amazon bar-raiser: raise the bar; probe Leadership Principles depth and hire/no-hire signal.
